scope: Bounded pre-execution repair review of Bash declaration expansion; all other previously reviewed helper and transfer bytes unchanged
evidence: The original preflight same-line ROOT/INCOMING/OUT declaration fails under set -euo pipefail with ROOT unbound in a literal Bash stdin smoke, matching the stopped host preflight.
The repaired preflight and stage scripts assign ROOT, INCOMING, and OUT on separate completed readonly commands; their remaining current call-chain guards were rechecked against the prior review.

All 12 files and byte counts match the new frozen manifest. Comparison with the retained old manifest finds only the two expected shell file hashes changed; source candidate, source manifest, bundle, runtime payload, and stage bindings are unchanged.

Each of the seven top-level shell scripts passed bash -n and an isolated literal declaration-only smoke under set -euo pipefail with the relevant variables unset. The smoke does not perform host or Docker operations.
The controller's read-only host check reports acceptance root and incoming/preflight absent after the initial abort; no setup or acceptance attempt has run.
boundary: This verdict covers safe declaration startup and exact packet identity before host execution. It does not certify PostgreSQL, runsc, suite, certificate, cleanup, or protected-host postflight outcomes.
